npj Digital Medicine · 2024 · 7:219

A portable and efficient dementia screening tool using eye tracking machine learning and virtual reality

Xu Y, Zhang C, Pan B, Yuan Q, Zhang X

연구는 평가 또는 선별검사에 관한 것으로 가정용 플랜의 치료 효과를 증명하지 않습니다. 정확한 모델과 용도와의 관련성을 확인하세요.

DOI ↗원본 자료 보기 (PDF)

영문 연구 요약

201 participants · VECA combined VR eye tracking with machine learning to estimate MoCA scores and classify cognitive impairment. The study used five-fold cross-validation.

VR eye-tracking assessment research; the paper includes Shenzhen Yiwei Technology affiliations. Commercial-model equivalence needs documentation. Shenzhen cohort; no cross-center training/testing. Screening agreement does not establish home-training benefit, disease prevention or diagnostic certainty.

Chinese Journal of Magnetic Resonance Imaging · 2024 · 15(6):49–53

Application value of structural MRI combined with computerized cognitive assessment based on VR eye-tracking technology in early diagnosis of Alzheimer’s disease

Wei Z et al.

연구는 평가 또는 선별검사에 관한 것으로 가정용 플랜의 치료 효과를 증명하지 않습니다. 정확한 모델과 용도와의 관련성을 확인하세요.

DOI ↗원본 자료 보기 (PDF)

영문 연구 요약

135 participants · 77 early AD / 58 cognitively unimpaired · A five-minute VR eye-tracking assessment was studied alongside structural MRI. Adding the assessment score improved discrimination compared with hippocampal volume alone (P < 0.001).

Clinical assessment plus imaging; not a home rehabilitation trial. Single-site clinical sample. The combined result requires MRI and must not be attributed to the headset alone.

BMC Public Health · 2024 · 24:1206

Community screening for dementia among older adults in China: a machine learning-based strategy

Zhang Y et al.

연구는 평가 또는 선별검사에 관한 것으로 가정용 플랜의 치료 효과를 증명하지 않습니다. 정확한 모델과 용도와의 관련성을 확인하세요.

DOI ↗원본 자료 보기 (PDF)

영문 연구 요약

823 adults aged 65 years and older · Machine-learning models combined selected AD8 questions with health characteristics in the SHARE community cohort.

Related community-screening methodology. This study did not test a VR device or demonstrate QuickMind efficacy. Performance relates to this cohort, selected health features and the study reference assessment; it is not a VR product performance claim.

American Journal of Alzheimer’s Disease & Other Dementias · 2024 · 39

Development and Validation of an Automatic Computerized Neurocognitive Battery in Chinese

Zhang J, Hong Z, Yang L, Li X, Ye F

연구는 평가 또는 선별검사에 관한 것으로 가정용 플랜의 치료 효과를 증명하지 않습니다. 정확한 모델과 용도와의 관련성을 확인하세요.

DOI ↗원본 자료 보기 (PDF)

영문 연구 요약

86 volunteers · ages 51–82 · The CNBC provided automated testing and scoring. Correlations with paired paper-based measures ranged from 0.256 to 0.666.

Related computerized-assessment validation. It is not a VR rehabilitation study; supplied material does not establish QuickMind product equivalence. Preliminary Chinese-speaking volunteer sample; score agreement is not treatment efficacy or diagnostic accuracy.
